description: Edits a custom claim's value or target; fields left out keep their value. changes: { value?, target? }.

changes.description: The fields to change. Custom claims apply across the configuration. Claims targeting access tokens also apply to client-credentials tokens. A custom roles claim can give roles to clients without their own roles.

name.description: The claim name. Required when adding; fixed afterwards.

value.description: The claim value: a string, number, boolean or array of strings, stored and emitted with that JSON type. Omitted or null: the empty string when adding, the stored value when editing.

configuration_id.description: The configuration id (from create_tenant or get_tenant).

name.description: The name of the claim to edit.

name: edit_custom_claim
